hypothesis: e31: shallow winter cold air from high-latitude land that no mountain barrier blocks lowers the annual-mean land temperature of the east sides and interiors of the northern continents. Under r31 these run warm (Manchuria +3.4, Korea +2.5, US Midwest +2.0, NE US +2.0, North China Plain +1.9 C annual bias) while the west coasts run cold.
reference: calibration/local_accuracy_20261023/r31_params.json, rerun on dev31 under the e31 source fingerprint (output/continental_cold_20261023/reference)
evaluation: scripts/benchmark_local.py --regions dev31 at 56 km, scripts/gate_local.py under policy_v2 (unchanged rules); a passing candidate then takes the paired 28 km check and the sealed six once
expected_risks: eastern Europe (-0.8 C) and western Europe (-0.4 C) are already too cold and get part of the shift; Iran and north India are mostly shielded by the barrier and the 25-45 deg ramp
